name: Corithras Moonrage
summary: In Dolanaar, Corithras Moonrage teaches newcomers about Teldrassil and its moonwells. His lessons reveal the tree’s place in kaldorei life and the burdens its people bear.

sections.title: Scholar of Dolanaar
sections.body: In Dolanaar, Corithras Moonrage teaches travelers about Teldrassil. Young kaldorei begin exploring the tree beyond Shadowglen, and he explains the history of their new home. He also speaks of the care its wilderness demands. In this changing era, survival calls for vigilance and respect for the natural order.

sections.title: Crown of the Earth
sections.body: Corithras gathers moonwell water for the druids in Darnassus. He sends travelers to draw pure water from moonwells across Teldrassil in specially crafted phials, then deliver it to Fandral Staghelm. This work helps him watch over the World Tree and preserve the wilderness against creeping corruption.

sections.title: The Burden of the Kaldorei
sections.body: Teldrassil bears a burden bound to its creation. Unlike ancient Nordrassil, the new World Tree was raised without the Dragon Aspects’ blessings. They refused Fandral Staghelm’s ambitious undertaking. Corithras weighs the loss of night elven immortality and the uncertain future his people face beneath an unblessed tree.

faq.answer: Corithras Moonrage is a night elf scholar in Dolanaar. He teaches travelers about Teldrassil and sends them to tend its sacred moonwells and test their waters.

faq.q: Where can Corithras Moonrage be found?
faq.answer: Corithras Moonrage can be found outdoors in Dolanaar, the crossroads village in southern Teldrassil.

faq.q: What is the Crown of the Earth questline about?
faq.answer: The Crown of the Earth asks travelers to draw water from moonwells across Teldrassil. Corithras sends the collected water to Fandral Staghelm in Darnassus, where the druids need it to replenish their moonwell.

faq.q: Why is Corithras concerned about Teldrassil's origins?
faq.answer: Corithras is concerned because Teldrassil was planted after the Third War to restore night elven immortality, but the Dragon Aspects refused to bless it. The tree lacks their protection, and his people remain mortal.

faq.q: What does Corithras teach new adventurers?
faq.answer: Corithras teaches about the sacrifices of the Third War, the founding of Teldrassil, and each kaldorei’s duty to defend their new woodland home.

faq.q: Is Corithras aligned with the Cenarion Circle or Darnassus?
faq.answer: Corithras is a loyal citizen and scholar of Darnassus, working with druids and priests in Dolanaar to watch over the forest and its waters.

angles.text: For night elves, Corithras offers a lesson in life after the Third War, including the loss of ancient immortality and the disputed creation of Teldrassil.
As a druid, you will find Corithras’s moonwell work tied to your calling. The rites help track the World Tree’s health and creeping ailments.
As a priest of Elune, you can help Corithras carry moonwell waters and preserve the spiritual and physical harmony of the wilds around Dolanaar.
